notes: Original cumulative Wowhead Looter item-specific material-occurrence table indexed on live item page: 24 reported disenchants of exact item 207213, 17 material occurrences, source-rounded 71%. This is one pooled source cohort for this item across its material rows. Positive stack range 1-2 is not a 0-N histogram; no stack-frequency counts or output unit totals. Material occurrences may overlap across outputs, so sums cannot prove overall zero-material disenchant casts. The live-page indexed summary does not independently expose dated raw completion events, sampling period, bonus IDs/actual item level at disenchant, patch or game build, enchanting skill/specialization, player identities, or per-cast output distribution. Added-in-patch 10.2.0 is item introduction, not sample timestamp. Do not interpret later Wowhead character preview or PTR mirrored counts as dated Dragonflight-patch results; do not import a second live/PTR snapshot as an independent cohort.
